# Jitterentropy r2 adapter

Source: https://github.com/smuellerDD/jitterentropy-library
Revision: `2aa10e2423fc7d34d67ef666d8eb186d236272d8` (3.8.0 development tree, pinned).
License: BSD 3-clause option, retained in LICENSE and source notices.

The entropy collection, SHA-3/XDRBG conditioning, startup tests, oversampling,
and continuous health tests are unchanged. We build the library at `-O0`,
without LTO, in freestanding mode with the internal thread timer disabled.
`entropy.c` enables the full health tests and caps memory at 2 MiB.

Adapter changes: the public header uses standard types without POSIX headers
in freestanding builds, and the x86 timer/pause backends use their existing
inline-assembly implementations instead of compiler intrinsic headers.
The unused status formatter is excluded. No entropy samples or random bytes
are logged. `JENT_CONF_ENABLE_MOCK_TIMER` is confined to host tests.
